reviews.title: Needs more editing options
reviews.text: Not working particularly well for me at the moment. It’s a US oriented list and out of five added items, three of them do not appear on the default lists. These are not unusual items, such as drain unblocker and washing up liquid, brandy. If I could easily add them to their natural category, ie ‘cleaning’ that wouldn’t be too bad but the only way I can see to add an item is to create a new folder and add it to that. And even that process is not obvious. It should be possible to create new items within their appropriate folders. I would be willing to pay the modest premium price but not until this basic feature is added and there is no indication that you would have this option if you pay premium. It’s a basic oversight.
